blocks.text: Aboitiz earned top accolades at the 2026 Philippines Real Estate Awards, with Aboitiz Economic Estates named Best Industrial Developer and Ajoya Cabanatuan recognized as Best Masterplanned Development. Together, the awards recognize an approach to real estate development that considers how places can support economic activity, respond to the needs of their end-users, and create lasting impact for the communities and regions around them. For Aboitiz Economic Estates, the Best Industrial Developer title reflects its track record in building investment-ready environments that help businesses establish, expand, and grow their operations in the country.
